name: @pipeworx/mcp-ga-medical-exclusions

tools.name: ga_medical_check_exclusion
tools.description: Is this healthcare provider excluded from the Georgia Medicaid program? Screens a person or business name and/or an NPI against the Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH) Office of Inspector General (OIG) List of Excluded Individuals and Entities — the state-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (see the leie pack) for Georgia specifically, and the sibling of ny_omig_check_exclusion (New York), ca_medical_check_exclusion (California), tx_medical_check_exclusion (Texas), fl_medical_check_exclusion (Florida) and pa_medical_check_exclusion (Pennsylvania). Answers "is this provider excluded from Georgia Medicaid", "check this NPI against the Georgia DCH OIG exclusions list", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for a Georgia Medicaid provider. An NPI match is an IDENTIFICATION (an exact, provider-specific identifier); a name match — even an exact one — is a CANDIDATE lead only, since this list carries no date of birth to tell same-named providers apart. Unlike the Texas/California/New York/Pennsylvania lists, this is a CURRENT-SNAPSHOT list, not an ever-excluded file — DCH removes a provider once reinstated rather than tracking a reinstatement date, so every match here is currently excluded. Pass npi to turn a name lead into an identification. Sourced from the Georgia DCH OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities, keyless.

name.description: Provider or business name to screen, e.g. "John Smith" or "Acme Pharmacy Inc". Matched against the provider's individual name and business name, any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification rather than a name lead — always pass it when known.

tools.name: ga_medical_exclusion_coverage
tools.description: What the Georgia DCH OIG exclusions data covers and how current it is: total exclusions currently on the list, how many carry an NPI, how many distinct provider types appear, and the oldest/newest sanction effective date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line note that this is a current-snapshot list (DCH removes reinstated providers rather than flagging them). Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have a sanction effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 1,300+ row list, not a page — answers "how many Georgia DCH OIG exclusions had a 2025 effective date". The response names the date field counted (sanction_date / DCH's SANCDATE, the only date field this list publishes). Sourced from the Georgia DCH OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities, keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ga-medical-exclusions forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ga-medical-exclusions pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
